outline.title: Maryam and the Moon Fox
outline.logline: Maryam sees a fox who longs for the moon and folds a paper rocket so she can send her new friend there.
outline.theme: turning a wish into flight with your own hands

characters.name: Maryam
characters.description: A five-year-old who loves the night sky and wants to send a fox all the way to the moon.

characters.name: Fox
characters.description: A quiet fox who steps out under the dark sky and dreams of standing on the moon.

beats.title: Night sky watch
beats.summary: Maryam sits by her window as the sky turns dark and stars appear. She sees a fox step out and look up at the moon.

beats.title: Maryam's idea
beats.summary: Maryam wants to help the fox reach the moon. She decides she will make a rocket from paper.

beats.title: Finding paper
beats.summary: Maryam and the fox gather big sheets of paper under the stars. She knows she will build the rocket herself.

beats.title: Folding the rocket
beats.summary: Maryam folds and tapes the paper rocket together fast with firm flaps. The fox watches the careful work under the quiet sky.

beats.title: Rocket ride
beats.summary: Maryam gives the rocket a gentle push and the fox rides it upward. The rocket lands softly on the moon with no flutter or sound.

beats.title: Moonlight return
beats.summary: The fox stands on the moon, then rides the paper rocket back down. Maryam meets the fox again under the same stars after sending it on its trip.

pages.text: Stars begin to shine. Maryam watches the fox step into the garden and lift its nose to the same moon.
Paper can carry the fox there. She steps back from the glass and reaches for the first sheet.
Out in the garden she gathers the paper alone. The fox sits close and watches the sheets.
Fold by fold the paper holds its shape in her hands. The fox sits very still and watches.
She gives the rocket a gentle push. It rises with the fox and she watches her idea fly.
The rocket settles on the moon. Maryam sees the fox step out under the quiet sky.
Maryam pictures the fox standing there now. Stars shine above the rocket the way she hoped.
Down comes the rocket again. Maryam watches the fox step out and the stars hold every wish in place.
